objective.title: Qualify exact real elementary equation and inequality solution sets

declared.summary: Qualify M4-W02-C02-T1 using one genuine compiled absent-API RED and 36 independent GREEN tests, with eight package-only NuGet client probes. Add exact real elementary equation solution sets for x=c and x^2=c, provable negative-square empty cases and selected closed-ray inequalities, preserving Unknown for real irrational roots and unproved forms. Inspect three local SHA-256 NuGet packages and keep C02, W02 and M4 open.
declared.value: Give .NET consumers a complete and exact real solution set only when a bounded mathematical rule proves it, without mistaking irrational or unsupported candidates for an empty solution set.
debtChanges: Compile a missing public exact real solving API RED against symbolics preview.6 before installing the new preview.7 source.

Thirty-six independent GREEN MSTests cover exact ordered quadratic roots, negative empty real solution sets, unknown positive nonsquare roots, rational fractions, single-variable linear equations, bounded real closed rays, original-input hashes, real-domain, unit and assumption refusals.
Only Finite, Empty, LowerClosedRay, UpperClosedRay and AllReal carry a complete qualified result; unknown and refused results have neither candidates nor proof/provenance.

A real-only structural source contract refuses complex/integer/bound targets, unknown arbitrary quotients, unqualified radicals, binary64 approximations, restricted sources and 128-bit rational budget overflow.
Eight independent pinned NuGet-only probes verify x^2=1, x^2=-1, x^2=2 Unknown, rational roots, real rays, unit refusal and no CAS or agent dependency.
Inspect the exact three local Math product package identities, net10.0 libraries, dependencies, byte counts and SHA-256 with a separate staged C# archive helper.

Advance only M4-W02-C02-T1 R/G/V and T1; activate C02 without closing it. T2, C03, M4-W02 and M4 remain unfinished. No public package, external provider, complex roots or sibling-repository integration.
declared.nextAction: After verified durable RS061 success, refine M4-W02-C02-T2 for root substitution against original expressions, false candidates, multiplicity and unknown/incomplete solution boundaries.
